```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse); library(paletteer); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
})
source('src/report_style.R')
source('src/report_io.R')
set_report_style()
for (directory in c('outliers','clusters','summary_statistics','disambiguation_characterization'))
  dir.create(directory, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)
known_settings <- !is.null(params$configuration_file) && file.exists(params$configuration_file)
cfg <- if(known_settings) jsonlite::read_json(params$configuration_file, simplifyVector=TRUE) else
  list(provenance_status='legacy_unknown', quality_universe='unknown')
if (known_settings && !identical(cfg$quality_universe, 'all_ct_candidates')) stop('Incompatible quality-filter universe')
if (!is.null(cfg$seed)) set.seed(as.integer(cfg$seed))
discovery <- pp_discovery(params$discovery_file)
retained <- pp_discovery(params$filtered_discovery_file)
if (!identical(names(retained),names(discovery))) stop('Retained discovery schema differs')
if (nrow(anti_join(retained, discovery, by=names(discovery))))
  stop('Retained discovery differs from input')
known_universe <- !is.null(params$quality_universe_file) && file.exists(params$quality_universe_file)
universe <- if(known_universe) jsonlite::read_json(params$quality_universe_file, simplifyVector=FALSE) else
  list(universe='input_positions_only', excluded_genes=NULL)
if (known_universe) {
  if (!identical(universe$universe, 'all_ct_candidates')) stop('Invalid quality universe record')
  actual_genes <- split(discovery$Position, discovery$Gene)
  if (!setequal(names(actual_genes), names(universe$genes))) stop('Quality universe gene coverage differs')
  for (gene in names(actual_genes)) {
    positions <- sort(unique(actual_genes[[gene]]))
    digest <- digest::digest(paste0(paste(sprintf('%.0f',positions),collapse='\n'),'\n'), algo='sha256',serialize=FALSE)
    expected <- universe$genes[[gene]]
    if (length(positions) != expected$positions || digest != expected$sha256) stop('Quality universe position coverage differs')
  }
}
stats <- pp_table(params$gene_stats_file, c('Gene','length','length_source','n_CAAS','n_CAAS_per_length','category')) %>%
  pp_numeric(c('length','n_CAAS','n_CAAS_per_length','threshold_extreme','threshold_dubious','stratum','stratum_genes',
               'stratum_min_length','stratum_max_length','q1','median','q3','iqr','pool_iqr','scale'))
removed_genes <- pp_table(params$removed_genes_file,c('Gene','category'))
# Both marks and the verdict are columns of gene_stats.tsv; an older table carries only the category.
as_flag <- function(x) tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c('true','t','1')
stats <- if (all(c('extreme','dubious','removed') %in% names(stats))) {
  stats %>% mutate(extreme=as_flag(extreme),dubious=as_flag(dubious),removed=as_flag(removed))
} else stats %>% mutate(extreme=category %in% c('Extreme','Both'),dubious=category %in% c('Dubious','Both'),
                        removed=Gene %in% removed_genes$Gene)
has_strata <- all(c('stratum','q1','q3','scale','scale_source') %in% names(stats))
switch_state <- function(name) if (known_settings && !is.null(cfg[[name]])) as_flag(cfg[[name]]) else NA
summary <- pp_table(params$filter_summary_file,c('Parameter','Minlen','Maxcaas','DiscardedCount')) %>%
  pp_numeric(c('Minlen','Maxcaas','DiscardedCount'))
selected <- pp_table(params$selected_cluster_file,c('Gene','Position','clustering_flag')) %>% pp_numeric('Position')
if (anyDuplicated(selected[c('Gene','Position')]) ||
    any(!selected$clustering_flag %in% c('Good','Discarded')) ||
    nrow(anti_join(distinct(discovery,Gene,Position),selected,by=c('Gene','Position'))) ||
    nrow(anti_join(selected,distinct(discovery,Gene,Position),by=c('Gene','Position')))) stop('Invalid cluster coverage')
annotation <- pp_table(params$gene_ensembl_file,c('gene','length'))
if (anyDuplicated(annotation$gene)) stop('Duplicate genes in annotation')
palette <- report_palette(10)
colors <- c(Normal=palette[10],Extreme=palette[3],Dubious=palette[1],Both=palette[7])
cluster_hits <- selected %>% filter(clustering_flag=='Discarded') %>% select(Gene,Position)
gene_events <- discovery %>% inner_join(removed_genes %>% rename(removal_category=category),by='Gene') %>%
  mutate(removal_stage='gene_filter')
cluster_events <- discovery %>% inner_join(cluster_hits,by=c('Gene','Position')) %>%
  mutate(removal_stage='cluster')
if (!isTRUE(cfg$remove_caas_clusters)) cluster_events <- cluster_events[0,]
# Events can overlap; impact totals count each gene/position/side only once.
removal_events <- bind_rows(gene_events,cluster_events)
expected_retained <- discovery %>% anti_join(removed_genes,by='Gene')
if (isTRUE(cfg$remove_caas_clusters)) expected_retained <- anti_join(expected_retained,cluster_hits,by=c('Gene','Position'))
if (known_settings && !setequal(do.call(paste,retained[c('Gene','Position','side')]),
              do.call(paste,expected_retained[c('Gene','Position','side')]))) stop('Filter decisions differ from retained artifact')
if (!known_settings) {
  # Actual removals can be recovered from the two tables; their cause cannot.
  removal_events <- anti_join(discovery, retained, by=c('Gene','Position','side')) %>%
    mutate(removal_stage='unknown')
}
write_tsv(removal_events,'disambiguation_characterization/removal_events.tsv')
```

# 1. Post-Processing Characterization

```{r analysis_label, results='asis'}
if (known_universe && isTRUE(universe$strict))
  cat('**Analysis: strict.** Only hypotheses without conserved pairs; every count, stratum and fence below comes from the strict tables and can differ from the normal analysis.\n\n')
```

## 1.1 Quality universe and configuration

These are quality filters on **all CT candidate positions**, including diagnostic
`side=none` rows with score zero. ASR categories, posterior values and positive scores
do not select the quality universe. Positions are counted once per `(gene, msa_pos)`,
across hypotheses and sides. Coordinates are **zero-based trimmed MSA columns**;
when MAP tables are supplied, interval spans use untrimmed alignment columns.

The observed completion record validates coverage of the candidates that were analyzed.
Genes intentionally excluded upstream are recorded separately; outlier thresholds
are calibrated over the analyzed candidate pool, rather than the entire background.

```{r configuration, results='asis'}
pp_show(tibble(Setting=names(cfg),Value=vapply(cfg, function(x) paste(x,collapse=', '), character(1))), 'Original filtering settings')
if (!known_settings || !known_universe)
  cat('**Legacy inputs: original settings or complete candidate coverage are unknown. This report describes the supplied input and retained tables; it does not certify an all-candidate universe or infer removal causes.**\n\n')
if (known_universe) cat(sprintf('\nUpstream excluded genes: %d.\n\n',length(universe$excluded_genes)))
counts <- tibble(Stage=c('Input','Retained'),
  Rows=c(nrow(discovery),nrow(retained)),
  Positions=c(nrow(distinct(discovery,Gene,Position)),nrow(distinct(retained,Gene,Position))),
  Genes=c(n_distinct(discovery$Gene),n_distinct(retained$Gene)))
pp_show(counts,'Rows, distinct candidate positions and genes')
write_tsv(counts,'summary_statistics/filter_impact.tsv')
```

## 1.2 Gene outliers

Genes are ordered by length and partitioned into equal-size strata. Within a stratum the fences are
Q3 + k × scale, with scale = max(stratum IQR, IQR of all genes with a length). **Extreme** is a count above the
far fence (k = `gene_filter_k_far`), for any gene. **Dubious** is a count above the near fence
(k = `gene_filter_k_near`) together with a cluster-train position. **Both** is a gene with the two marks.
Each rule has its own switch (`remove_extreme_genes`, `remove_dubious_genes`); this report shows both marks
whatever the switches say, so that each rule can be judged before deciding which to apply (section 1.3).
Genes without usable lengths remain visible but cannot receive thresholds. Densities are
candidate positions per **100 units of the effective length**. MAP lengths are untrimmed
alignment columns; the annotation fallback uses its `length` column, which is
the genomic span in base pairs for pipeline-generated Ensembl annotations.
Other annotations may have unspecified units. Different denominator units are
not directly comparable; the length sources are reported explicitly.

Click an outlier plot to zoom in; click again to restore it.

```{r outliers, results='asis', dpi=180}
pp_show(count(stats,category,name='Genes'),'Gene categories by mark (Extreme, Dubious, Both)')
pp_show(count(stats,length_source,name='Genes'),'Effective length sources')
if (nrow(stats)) {
  pp_plot(ggplot(stats,aes(n_CAAS,fill=category))+geom_histogram(bins=30)+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+labs(x='Distinct candidate positions',y='Genes',fill='Category'),
    'outliers/outlier_counts.png')
  density <- stats %>% filter(is.finite(n_CAAS_per_length))
  if (nrow(density)) pp_plot(ggplot(density,aes(n_CAAS_per_length,fill=category))+
    geom_histogram(bins=30)+scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
    facet_wrap(~length_source,scales='free_x',labeller=as_labeller(c(
      untrimmed_alignment_columns='Untrimmed alignment columns',genomic_bp='Genomic base pairs',annotation_units='Annotation units')))+
    labs(x='Candidate positions per 100 effective length units',y='Genes',fill='Category'),
    'outliers/outlier_density.png')
} else cat('No candidate genes; no outlier distribution to plot.\n\n')
```

## 1.3 Gene filter diagnostic

### Fences by length stratum

```{r strata, results='asis'}
strata_tbl <- tibble()
if (has_strata && any(is.finite(stats$stratum))) {
  strata_tbl <- stats %>% filter(is.finite(stratum)) %>% group_by(Stratum=stratum) %>% summarise(
    Genes=n(), Min_length=first(stratum_min_length), Max_length=first(stratum_max_length),
    Q1=first(q1), Median=first(median), Q3=first(q3), IQR=first(iqr), Pooled_IQR=first(pool_iqr),
    Scale=first(scale), Scale_from=if_else(first(scale_source)=='pool','pooled IQR','stratum IQR'),
    Far_fence=first(threshold_extreme), Near_fence=first(threshold_dubious),
    Extreme=sum(extreme), Dubious=sum(dubious), .groups='drop')
  write_tsv(strata_tbl,'outliers/stratum_summary.tsv')
  pp_show(strata_tbl %>% mutate(across(where(is.double),~round(.x,2))),
          'Length strata: range, count quartiles, scale, fences and genes marked by each rule')
  flat <- strata_tbl %>% filter(IQR==0, Pooled_IQR==0)
  if (nrow(flat)) cat(sprintf(paste0('**No dispersion in %d of %d strata (stratum %s): the stratum IQR and the pooled IQR are both 0, ',
    'so the scale is 0 and both fences equal Q3. In those strata every gene above Q3 is Extreme, and Dubious when it also ',
    'carries a train; the fence marks the step above Q3 of a count distribution without spread, not a statistical outlier.**\n\n'),
    nrow(flat), nrow(strata_tbl), paste(flat$Stratum, collapse=', ')))
  if (any(strata_tbl$Scale_from=='pooled IQR' & strata_tbl$Pooled_IQR>0))
    cat('Strata marked "pooled IQR" take the IQR of all genes as scale because their own IQR is smaller.\n\n')
} else cat('Stratum statistics are not in this gene table (no gene has a length, or the table predates them).\n\n')
```

```{r strata_plot, results='asis', dpi=180}
if (nrow(strata_tbl)) {
  stratum_labels <- strata_tbl %>% transmute(stratum=Stratum, Stratum_label=sprintf('Stratum %d (%s-%s)', Stratum,
    format(round(Min_length),big.mark=','), format(round(Max_length),big.mark=',')))
  fence_lines <- strata_tbl %>% select(stratum=Stratum, Far=Far_fence, Near=Near_fence) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Far,Near), names_to='Fence', values_to='count') %>% left_join(stratum_labels, by='stratum') %>%
    mutate(Stratum_label=factor(Stratum_label, levels=stratum_labels$Stratum_label))
  by_stratum <- stats %>% filter(is.finite(stratum)) %>% left_join(stratum_labels, by='stratum') %>%
    mutate(Stratum_label=factor(Stratum_label, levels=stratum_labels$Stratum_label))
  pp_plot(ggplot(by_stratum, aes(n_CAAS, fill=category)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1, boundary=-0.5) +
    geom_vline(data=fence_lines, aes(xintercept=count, linetype=Fence), color='grey20') +
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors) + scale_linetype_manual(values=c(Far='dashed', Near='dotted')) +
    facet_wrap(~Stratum_label, scales='free') +
    labs(x='Distinct candidate positions per gene', y='Genes', fill='Category', linetype='Fence'),
    'outliers/stratum_count_distributions.png', width=12, height=8)
}
```

### Genes marked by each rule

```{r flagged_genes, results='asis'}
train_positions <- cluster_hits %>% count(Gene, name='Train_positions')
flagged <- stats %>% filter(extreme | dubious) %>% left_join(train_positions, by='Gene') %>%
  mutate(Train_positions=coalesce(Train_positions, 0L)) %>%
  transmute(Gene, Length=length, CAAS_positions=n_CAAS, Stratum=if (has_strata) stratum else NA_real_,
            Rule=category, Cluster_train=Train_positions>0, Train_positions, Removed_in_this_run=removed) %>%
  arrange(desc(CAAS_positions), Gene)
write_tsv(flagged,'outliers/flagged_genes.tsv')
pp_show(flagged, 'Genes marked Extreme, Dubious or Both')
```

### What each switch would remove

Positions are distinct `(gene, position)` pairs of the input table; a gene removal drops all of its positions.
`Extreme rule` is `remove_extreme_genes` alone, `Dubious rule` is `remove_dubious_genes` alone.

```{r switch_scenarios, results='asis'}
positions_by_gene <- discovery %>% distinct(Gene, Position) %>% count(Gene, name='positions')
total_positions <- sum(positions_by_gene$positions); total_genes <- nrow(positions_by_gene)
scenario <- function(label, genes) {
  lost <- sum(positions_by_gene$positions[positions_by_gene$Gene %in% genes])
  tibble(Scenario=label, Genes=length(genes), Genes_pct=round(100*length(genes)/max(total_genes,1),2),
         CAAS_positions=lost, CAAS_positions_pct=round(100*lost/max(total_positions,1),2))
}
extreme_genes <- stats$Gene[stats$extreme]; dubious_genes <- stats$Gene[stats$dubious]
scenarios <- bind_rows(
  scenario('Neither rule', character()),
  scenario('Extreme rule', extreme_genes),
  scenario('Dubious rule', dubious_genes),
  scenario('Both rules', union(extreme_genes, dubious_genes)),
  scenario('Marked by both (Both)', intersect(extreme_genes, dubious_genes)),
  scenario('Removed in this run', stats$Gene[stats$removed]))
write_tsv(scenarios,'outliers/switch_scenarios.tsv')
pp_show(scenarios, sprintf('Genes and CAAS positions lost (of %d genes, %d positions)', total_genes, total_positions))
state <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) 'unknown' else if (x) 'on' else 'off'
cat(sprintf('Switches in this run: `remove_extreme_genes` %s, `remove_dubious_genes` %s.\n\n',
            state(switch_state('remove_extreme_genes')), state(switch_state('remove_dubious_genes'))))
```

```{r removed_genes_table, results='asis'}
pp_show(removed_genes,'Genes removed under the switches of this run')
```

# 2. Cluster Filtering Analysis

Each interval must satisfy **both** its minimum span (`filter_minlen`) and minimum
number of candidate positions (`filter_min_positions`), and have density ≥
`filter_maxcaas`. For compatibility, an unset count parameter preserves the legacy
rule exactly: the gene must have at least `filter_minlen` candidates, while each
interval is checked only for span and density. Set `filter_min_positions`
explicitly to apply the independent count requirement to every interval.

These clusters are quality flags for spatial concentration; they do not establish
that a region is erroneous or that substitutions have independent origins.
Flagging and removing are separate operations. The selected combination determines
the downstream result in both filter and exploratory modes.

```{r cluster_summary, results='asis'}
pp_show(summary,'Distinct positions flagged per parameter combination (Maxcaas in percent)')
write_tsv(summary,'clusters/filter_summary.tsv')
if (nrow(summary)>1) pp_plot(ggplot(summary,aes(factor(Minlen),DiscardedCount,color=factor(Maxcaas),group=factor(Maxcaas)))+
  geom_point()+geom_line()+labs(x='Minimum interval span',y='Distinct positions flagged',color='Density (%)'),
  'clusters/parameter_sweep_overview.png')
cluster_by_gene <- selected %>% group_by(Gene) %>% summarise(
  candidate_positions=n(),flagged_positions=sum(clustering_flag=='Discarded'),
  flagged_coordinates=paste(Position[clustering_flag=='Discarded'],collapse=', '),.groups='drop') %>%
  mutate(gene_removed=Gene %in% removed_genes$Gene,
         effect=case_when(!known_settings~'Original removal rule unknown',gene_removed~'Complete gene removal',!isTRUE(cfg$remove_caas_clusters)~'Flagged only; retained',
           flagged_positions==0~'Retained',flagged_positions==candidate_positions~'All positions removed by cluster filter',
           TRUE~'Partial position removal by cluster filter'))
write_tsv(cluster_by_gene,'clusters/selected_cluster_genes.tsv')
# Exact staged inputs only: no recursive search through previous published runs.
files <- sort(list.files(params$filter_dir,pattern='\\.filtered\\.',full.names=TRUE))
if (length(files)!=nrow(summary)) stop('Cluster sweep artifacts differ from summary')
```

**Selected combination: flagged positions and actual effect**

```{r cluster_table}
cluster_display <- cluster_by_gene %>% filter(flagged_positions>0) %>%
  mutate(flagged_coordinates=paste0('<details><summary>Show ', flagged_positions,
    ' coordinates</summary>', htmltools::htmlEscape(flagged_coordinates), '</details>'))
if (nrow(cluster_display)) {
  DT::datatable(cluster_display, rownames=FALSE,
    escape=which(names(cluster_display) != 'flagged_coordinates'),
    options=list(pageLength=10, lengthMenu=c(10,20,50,100)))
} else knitr::asis_output('No flagged positions.')
```


# 3. Characterizing CAAS Disambiguation

A positive row represents one side (`top` or `bottom`); a site may have both.
If neither side scores positively, `side=none` preserves a diagnostic row.
Categories are `convergent`, `divergent`, `single`, `no_change`,
`symplesiomorphic` and `cross_hypothesis`.

The score averages species over their design hypotheses, including zeros for
non-detection, weights species within domains by their mean PSS and averages
all domains equally. `derived_agreement` is descriptive and does not enter the
score. The score is **not a calibrated probability of independent origins**.

## 3.1 Actual removals and filter overlap

Extreme and dubious membership comes from the marks of `gene_stats.tsv`, using the
length-stratified far and near fences described in section 1.2; the marks do not
depend on the switches. Dubious also requires a cluster-flagged position. `Both`
contributes to both columns. Cluster removal can remove individual positions
without removing the whole gene.

```{r overlap, results='asis'}
flags <- stats %>% mutate(Extreme=category %in% c('Extreme','Both'),
  Dubious=category %in% c('Dubious','Both'),
  Cluster_flagged=Gene %in% cluster_hits$Gene,
  Cluster_removed=if(known_settings) isTRUE(cfg$remove_caas_clusters) & Cluster_flagged else NA)
overlap <- flags %>% count(Extreme,Dubious,Cluster_removed,name='Genes')
write_tsv(flags,'outliers/filter_overlap_gene_table.tsv')
write_tsv(overlap,'outliers/filter_overlap_summary.tsv')
pp_show(overlap,'Gene membership in the Extreme and Dubious rules; cluster removal can be partial')
if (nrow(removal_events)) pp_show(removal_events %>% count(removal_stage,side,convergence_type,name='Rows'),
  'Removal events by stage and side (stages can overlap)') else cat('No removal events.\n\n')
```

## 3.2 Side-aware categories before and after filtering

```{r categories, results='asis'}
patterns <- bind_rows(mutate(discovery,stage='Input'),mutate(retained,stage='Retained')) %>%
  count(stage,side,convergence_type,name='Rows')
write_tsv(patterns,'disambiguation_characterization/pattern_parallel.tsv')
if (nrow(patterns)) pp_plot(ggplot(patterns,aes(convergence_type,Rows,fill=stage))+
  geom_col(position='dodge')+facet_wrap(~side)+coord_flip()+
  labs(x='Convergence category',y='Rows per side',fill='Stage'),
  'disambiguation_characterization/pattern_parallel.png') else cat('Empty observed result; no categories to plot.\n\n')
```

## 3.3 Genomic distribution of retained candidates

Each point is a gene with retained candidates. Chromosomes share a continuous
axis; density uses the annotated genomic span in base pairs for every gene.

```{r genomic, results='asis'}
if (all(c('chr','start','end') %in% names(annotation))) {
  genomic <- retained %>% distinct(Gene,Position) %>% count(Gene,name='positions') %>%
    mutate(annotation_gene = if_else(Gene %in% annotation$gene, Gene,
      sub('\\.[A-Z][a-z]+_[a-z]+(_[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$', '', sub('\\.prot$', '', Gene), perl=TRUE)))
  .mapped_genes <- genomic$annotation_gene[genomic$annotation_gene %in% annotation$gene]
  if (anyDuplicated(.mapped_genes)) stop('Multiple retained genes map to the same genomic annotation: ',
    paste(unique(.mapped_genes[duplicated(.mapped_genes)]), collapse=', '))
  genomic <- genomic %>%
    left_join(annotation %>% select(annotation_gene=gene,chr,start,end),by='annotation_gene') %>%
    select(-annotation_gene) %>%
    pp_numeric(c('start','end')) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chr),nzchar(chr),is.finite(start),is.finite(end),start>=0,end>=start) %>%
    mutate(midpoint=(start+end)/2, genomic_length=end-start+1,
           density=positions/genomic_length)
  write_tsv(genomic,'disambiguation_characterization/retained_genomic_density.tsv')
  if (nrow(genomic)) {
    chromosomes <- genomic %>% group_by(chr) %>% summarise(chr_end=max(end),.groups='drop') %>%
      mutate(chr_label=sub('^chr','',chr,ignore.case=TRUE),
        chr_number=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(chr_label)),
        chr_order=case_when(is.finite(chr_number)~chr_number,
          toupper(chr_label)=='X'~Inf, toupper(chr_label)=='Y'~Inf,
          TRUE~Inf),
        chr_group=case_when(is.finite(chr_number)~0L,toupper(chr_label)=='X'~1L,
          toupper(chr_label)=='Y'~2L,TRUE~3L)) %>%
      arrange(chr_group,chr_order,chr_label,chr) %>%
      mutate(offset=lag(cumsum(chr_end),default=0),center=offset+chr_end/2,
             chromosome_index=row_number())
    genomic <- genomic %>% left_join(chromosomes %>% select(chr,offset,chromosome_index),by='chr') %>%
      mutate(cumulative_position=offset+midpoint, chromosome_band=factor(chromosome_index %% 2))
    pp_plot(ggplot(genomic,aes(cumulative_position,density))+
      geom_vline(data=chromosomes,aes(xintercept=offset+chr_end),
                 linetype='dotted',color='grey60',alpha=.7,linewidth=.4,inherit.aes=FALSE)+
      geom_point(alpha=.85,size=3.1,color='#2E86AB')+
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=chromosomes$center,labels=chromosomes$chr_label,
                         expand=expansion(mult=c(.005,.005)))+
      scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_number(scale_cut=scales::cut_short_scale()),
                         expand=expansion(mult=c(.02,.08)))+
      labs(title='Genomic distribution of retained CAAS density',
           subtitle=sprintf('n = %d genes with retained CT positions | y = retained positions / gene length (bp)', nrow(genomic)),
           x='Chromosome',y='CAAS density (retained positions / gene length)')+
      theme_minimal(base_size=24)+
      theme(plot.title=element_text(face='bold',size=28),plot.subtitle=element_text(size=20),
            axis.title=element_text(size=22),axis.text=element_text(size=18),
            panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank()),
      'disambiguation_characterization/manhattan_retained.png',
      width=min(22,max(16,10+.55*nrow(chromosomes))),
      height=min(12,max(9,8+.015*nrow(genomic))))
  } else cat('No retained candidates with genomic annotation.\n\n')
} else cat('Genomic coordinates unavailable; genomic plot omitted.\n\n')
```

# 4. Filtering Impact

Counts of candidate positions include diagnostic sites; counts of positive sites
below require at least one positive side. A site with two positive sides counts
once in the positive-site total.

```{r impact, results='asis'}
positive_counts <- tibble(Stage=c('Input','Retained'),
  Positive_sites=c(nrow(discovery %>% filter(asr_path_score>0) %>% distinct(Gene,Position)),
                   nrow(retained %>% filter(asr_path_score>0) %>% distinct(Gene,Position))),
  Diagnostic_sites=c(sum(discovery$side=='none'),sum(retained$side=='none')))
pp_show(positive_counts,'Positive and diagnostic positions')
write_tsv(positive_counts,'summary_statistics/positive_diagnostic_impact.tsv')
```
